CustomField.inlineHelpText: Unique identifier for this outreach tactic. Convention: {CHANNEL-PREFIX}-{CAMPAIGN-SHORT-NAME}-{SEQUENCE} — for example, EM-FY26-YEAREND-01 for the first email tactic of a campaign with Short Name "fy26-yearend". Equivalent to utm_content in web analytics. Must be unique across all Outreach Source Codes. Stored on Gift Transactions and used by the Outreach Summary rollup to attribute revenue to this source code.
